description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Croatia working-day offset. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when croatia 2026 article 1 general holidays over an explicitly selected Monday-Friday planning baseline. Article 2 memorial days do not add rest. Article 3 religious rights depend on the person and, for specified festivals, the chosen day; they are not included in a universal union. Individual shifts, replacement weekly rest, employer/local/sector/school/bank schedules, payroll, legal deadlines and future years are not computed.
What it computes: Adds or subtracts Croatia authority-scope working days in exact coverage. Requires explicit mon_fri_planning; memorials and person-specific religious rights are not general rest.
Example user requests: Add or subtract Croatia working days around Good Friday is not a general statutory holiday. | Add or subtract Croatia working days around Corpus Christi. | Add or subtract Croatia working days around Independence memorial is not a rest holiday.
Inputs: start_date (date); working_days (integer); work_schedule (enum).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-01-01","working_days":0,"work_schedule":"mon_fri_planning"}
Outputs: start_date, result_date, working_days_added, calendar_days_elapsed, public_holidays_skipped, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources, work_schedule, is_statutory_holiday, is_commemorative_day, religious_rest_scope, payroll_scope.
Formula: planning_workday = weekday AND no article_1_statutory_holiday
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/croatia-public-add-working-days with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/croatia-public-add-working-days.md

work_schedule.description: Required explicit Monday-Friday planning baseline; not an individual statutory roster.

working_days.description: Signed offset; start date excluded for non-zero offsets.

name: add_hr_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Croatia 2026 article 1 general holiday facts with explicit Monday-Friday planning baseline

day_type.description: statutory_holiday, weekend_baseline or regular_workday; memorials alone do not add rest.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

is_commemorative_day.description: Whether result.date has an article 2 memorial; this does not add rest.

is_statutory_holiday.description: Whether result.date is an article 1 general statutory holiday.

religious_rest_scope.description: article_3_person_specific_not_computed: no union or inferred personal religious identity.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Add Croatia Working Days
